columns.name: num_disabled_students
columns.description: The number of disabled students in the organization, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: per_male_students
columns.description: The percentage of male students in the organization.

columns.name: longest_time_absence
columns.description: The longest time for a student from the department to be absent from school, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: per_students_have_due_payment
columns.description: The percentage of students who have a due payment in the organization.

columns.name: ratio_between_female_and_male
columns.description: The ratio between the number of female and male students who joined the organization, calculated as the number of female students divided by the number of male students.

columns.name: gender
columns.description: The gender of the student, set to 'M' for male 'F' for female.

columns.name: female_and_no_due_payments
columns.description: Set to 1 if the student is female and has no due payments, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: join_more_than_one_org
columns.description: Set to 1 if the student has joined more than one organization, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: not_file_for_bankruptcy
columns.description: Set to 1 if the student has not filed for bankruptcy, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: has_the_longest_absence_duration
columns.description: Set to 1 if the student has the longest absence duration from school, otherwise, set to 0.

models.name: schools
models.description: Each record represents a unique school.

columns.name: num_disabled_students
columns.description: The number of disabled students in the school, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: per_male_and_air_force
columns.description: The percentage of male students in the air force department among all students enrolled in the school.

columns.name: per_disabled_female_students
columns.description: The percentage of disabled female students in the school.

columns.name: per_students_file_bankruptcy
columns.description: The percentage of students who have filed for bankruptcy in the school.

columns.name: per_navy_make_up_num_students
columns.description: The percentage of enrolled students in the school who enlisted in the navy.
